_sources: No provider was consulted for this file. Every rate below is invented so the quickstart has something to run on.
Replace each figure from the provider's own live pricing page, then set _verified to the date you did so.
_refresh_rule: Re-verify every rate on the day you deliver a paid report and archive a dated copy of this file alongside it.
_verified_note: Deliberately far-future so a clone months from now still runs the documented example. A real table carries the date you actually checked the rates, and the tool refuses it after 45 days.

_not_modelled.batch: 50% off input and output on both providers. Model manually as a separate finding for latency-tolerant workloads.
_not_modelled.thinkingTokens: Reasoning tokens bill as output but are absent from the response body. Ask for BILLED output tokens, not response lengths.
_not_modelled.longContext: Both providers meter long-context requests differently above certain thresholds. Rates here are short-context.
_not_modelled.cacheTTL: cacheWritePerMTok assumes the 5-minute TTL (1.25x base input). A 1-hour cache costs 2x base input.

_WARNING: EXAMPLE VALUES ONLY - placeholders, not real provider rates. Model keys match sample-calls.json so the quickstart runs, but every figure is fictional. Replace each rate from the providers' live pricing pages and set _verified to the date you checked them.
